subject: CS242
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 3 Arabic videos. The English selection is strong, with highly-viewed, relevant videos for all topics. For Arabic, coverage was challenging; two topics (PCP, Cook-Levin) had no specifically relevant videos available. For the remaining topics, suitable academic lectures were found, though one selection required using the low-view-count exception rule due to a lack of high-reach candidates.

coverage.note: No candidates found that specifically cover Post's Correspondence Problem in Arabic.
No candidates found that specifically teach the proof of the Cook-Levin theorem in Arabic.

Differentiating P, NP, NP-Complete, and NP-Hard
